# Outcome

`bam_tagger`/`py-bam-tagger` (one ~50-flag command) was refactored into
**`sam-tagger`** (`src/sam_tagger/`, v3.0.0): three focused subcommands with
fixed I/O contracts, a single-source-of-truth pydantic/TOML config, and the
redundant tags removed. Plan: [20260804-195910_refactor-sam-tagger.plan.qmd](./20260804-195910_refactor-sam-tagger.plan.qmd).

Eight staged commits (one per phase):

| # | Commit                                                                    |
|---|---------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| 1 | `chore: scaffold sam-tagger project`                                      |
| 2 | `feat: port BED interval parser and Parquet stats writer`                 |
| 3 | `feat: pydantic TOML config loader (single source of truth)`              |
| 4 | `feat: port processing core (CIGAR + cs-tag helpers)`                     |
| 5 | `feat: cyclopts CLI with annotate / error-stats / pileup subcommands`     |
| 6 | `feat: stats collectors (tag/error/pileup), decoupled from the CLI`       |
| 7 | `feat: per-subcommand orchestrators + entrypoint`                         |
| 8 | `test: integration suite for the three subcommands`                       |

# What changed vs. the port

- **Subcommands.** `annotate` (BAM→BAM + FASTQ + tag stats), `error-stats`
  (BAM→7 Parquet, read-only), `pileup` (BAM→Parquet, read-only). Each binds to
  a dataclass via `Annotated[Args, Parameter(name="")]`, so the dataclass is the
  single source of truth for both CLI flags and the orchestrator — no field-list
  duplication, clean `--config` (not `--args.config`).
- **Config.** The 13 CLI override flags + the "generic" CSV columns + the
  duplicated Path 1/Path 2 branches are gone. One pydantic-validated TOML file
  (`config.py`, `RefConfig(extra="forbid")`); `seq_name`/`seq_len` come from the
  BAM header. `FL` and the CIGAR-only tags need no config.
- **Tags dropped.** `HI`/`HD` (= `IL>0` / `DL>0`) and `SP` (= `SS+1`). Kept:
  `FL MS ME TC AP SS ES DM EE IL DL NB`.
- **Robustness.** `annotate` validates and fails fast before opening any output
  (e.g. `--add-tc` without a tc config, `--add-nb` without `--fasta`). Resources
  managed with `ExitStack` + `closing()`.

# Verification (evidence)

- **Tests:** `pixi run -e dev pytest -q` → **25 passed** (8 config unit + 17
  integration: tagging, tag stats, error-stats, 9 pileup scenarios, soft-clip +
  sub-read extraction). Ported from py-bam-tagger; behavioral assertions
  preserved (only HI/HD/SP removed).
- **Lint:** `pixi run -e dev ruff check src/ tests/` → **All checks passed!**
- **Typecheck:** `pixi run -e dev pyright src/sam_tagger/` → **0 errors**.
- **End-to-end smoke** through the `sam-tagger` binary: `annotate` wrote FL=1 /
  TC=OnTarget / EE counts; `error-stats` wrote all 7 Parquet files; `pileup`
  emitted per-position rows.

# Embedding into snakeforge-templates (next step, not done here)

`sam-tagger` fits the existing pattern (`cs_tagger`, `sam_formatter` kits) and
runs after `cs-tagger` (`minimap2 → cs-tagger → sam-tagger`). The follow-up is a
`snakeforge_templates/sam_tagger/` kit: a BaseRule wrapper per subcommand +
`environment.yaml` (conda `pysam`, pypi `polars/cyclopts/loguru/pydantic`,
editable `sam-tagger`) + fixtures + `guide.qmd` + a Tier-2 shell test. The three
fixed-contract subcommands map one-to-one onto three templates (the bcftools
model). Out of scope for this refactor.

# Notes / deviations from plan

- `processing.py` landed as its **own** commit (4), after `config.py` (3), to
  respect the import dependency (`processing` imports `config.ApParams`); the
  plan had listed it under stage 2.
- `test_processing.py` unit tests were folded into the integration suite rather
  than ported separately — the integration tests cover the CIGAR/cs logic
  end-to-end and are the real regression net.
- Dev tooling (`pytest`/`ruff`/`pyright`) lives in the `dev` environment, so dev
  tasks take `pixi run -e dev <task>` (documented in the README).
